Samir B: RC promotion blocked — `smoke-seed` failing repeatedly on staging (4/4). Blocking cut in 1h.
deploy-bot: Promotion held for run 2026-03-25T11:21Z. Failing checks: smoke-seed. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/33221
Elena T: failures began after bumping `redwood/base:py310-2026-03-22`. stack shows `psycopg2.connect()` timeouts during fixture load.
Samir B: options: pin base to last-green and re-run smoke (fast), or revert bump and run full matrix (takes >3h). change window ends soon.
Elena T: I can push a temp pin commit. If smoke still flakes we'll revert the bump tonight and schedule a patch release.
Oncall_SRE: if we pin and cut, I'll add a canary monitor for DB seed latency and escalate on >10% failure.
Samir B: go ahead and pin. please include the commit SHA in release notes and create an investigation ticket.
Elena T: pushed `ci: temp pin base -> py310-2026-03-12` on branch `rc/temp-pin-1700202468` and triggered manual promote.
deploy-bot: Manual promote triggered by Elena T. CI run id 33222 queued.
deploy-bot: CI run 33222 smoke-seed: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:
InfraBot: Created ticket #5987 for root cause: includes image diffs, seed logs, and timing histograms.
Samir B: drafting release notes: "RC 2026.03.25 — temporary base image pin to mitigate staging seed timeouts; see #5987 for follow-up." Will cut after merge.
Oncall_SRE: monitor in place. I'll hold pager until we see canary data for 15m.
Elena T: added a short CI tweak to run the seed with +10s timeout for the next 3 cycles to reduce noise while triage continues.
Samir B: cutting RC. If #5987 points to client/driver regression we'll plan a fix+re-cut outside the window. Thanks team.
